GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead half clear, pushed along a touch turn, headed Straightening Up , half off 200m b4 run ended and weakned final100m # led/faded

Jumped okay & Went Forward to Two Wide joint Lead settling down, went a half length clear at 750m, Held Together in front middle stages, joined again as they turned, Headed rounding turn and trailed better than a length Straightening Up , kept battling in Straight # battled on ok
Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 3 Lengths 3 Wide , Moved Up to 2 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced three wide, without cover, throughout the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to lead on fence by 0.75 Lengths , Held Together in front & led by a head turning, Headed 200m but kept battling to post # led/battled on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out under pressure over the final 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 2nd 2 lengths. 2nd turn. weakened # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly during the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to joint Lead on fence initially, Headed 700m, trailed rail by under a length turning, hugged fence rounding turn, railed up after straightening, challenged leader taking over at 200m, steered a bit wider as it got out to lead nearly 2 Lengths , kept going to post but Headed by winner 40m from the line. # battled on okay
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Apprentice rider dropped her whip near the 350m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to 2 Lengths Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led 1 length turning, led into the Straight and Headed at the 150m, lost a couple of lengths to line. (Cross-over Nose Band FIRST TIME) # weakened last 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out under pressure near the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down Two Wide trailing a long head, Drifted Back to 3 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in straight. (Winkers FIRST TIME) # no excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 700m was steadied after hanging out across heels. Continued to hang out from this point to the 500m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to 1 length joint Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led 2.5 Lengths jointly turning, Headed 350m and Dropped Out in straight. (Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) ON) # weak once headed

Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 4.5 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to 3.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, faded a little in straight. First start: Need to see again. [Stewards: Rider reported dismounting that she believed it unsteady and may have temporarily held its breath during the race. Post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.] # slowly away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. The rider reported dismounting after the race, stating she believed her mount appeared unsteady and may have temporarily held its breath during the event. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.
